cases.sentence: Когда наступил ___ и израильтяне уже поселились в своих городах, весь народ, как один человек, собрался на площади перед Водными воротами.
cases.explain: «седьмой месяц» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahweh had commanded to Israel.

cases.sentence: Когда наступил седьмой месяц и израильтяне уже поселились в своих городах, весь народ, как один человек, собрался на площади перед ___.
cases.explain: «Водными воротами» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahweh had commanded to Israel.

cases.sentence: И в ___ седьмого месяца священник Ездра принес Закон на собрание, где присутствовали мужчины и женщины и все, кто способен понимать.
cases.explain: «первый день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

cases.sentence: И в первый день ___ священник Ездра принес Закон на собрание, где присутствовали мужчины и женщины и все, кто способен понимать.
cases.explain: «седьмого месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

cases.sentence: Он читал его вслух с рассвета до полудня на площади, что перед ___, перед мужчинами, женщинами и прочими, кто мог понимать.
cases.explain: «Водными воротами» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand. The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.

cases.sentence: На ___ месяца главы семейств всего народа вместе со священниками и левитами собрались вокруг книжника Ездры, чтобы внимать словам Закона.
cases.explain: «второй день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: On the second day, the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe, to study the words of the law.

cases.sentence: Люди вышли и принесли ветви, и сделали себе шалаши, каждый у себя на крыше и во дворах, во дворе дома Божьего и на площади у ___, и на той, что у ворот Ефрема.
cases.explain: «Водных ворот» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So the people went out, and brought them, and made themselves temporary shelters, everyone on the roof of his house, in their courts, in the courts of God’s house, in the wide place of the water gate, and in the wide place of Ephraim’s gate.

cases.sentence: Изо дня в день — с ___ до последнего — Ездра читал из книги Божьего Закона.
cases.explain: «первого дня» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

cases.sentence: Они отмечали праздник семь дней, а на ___, по уставу, было торжественное собрание.
cases.explain: «восьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

cases.sentence: Они отмечали праздник семь дней, а на восьмой день, по уставу, было ___.
cases.explain: «торжественное собрание» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.
